notes.title: the Breath is coming at 9/19
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

the Breath is coming, at 9/19.

Like a bee traveled a very long time and finally find flower, I don't know if there is any honey in there, but flower is beautiful enough to wash all unhappy feelings. 

I am happy to be here with you to read and feel it, with some imagination will be good.

Wish this little work can bring you something personal.

Have a good day,

Kang.
